calculation.description: For each asset, average the negative close-to-open return over the latest three completed sessions; higher values indicate stronger intraday weakness and a contrarian long signal.
calculation.timing: Computed only through the previous completed session at decision time; forward return is next close-to-close return.

metrics.icir_definition: mean daily Spearman IC / sample standard deviation of daily IC

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (0.04807), 2023-2024 (0.036749), and 2025-2026 through cutoff (0.056389). Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.

signal_provenance.artifact: recomputable exact-date aligned signal from open and close
